findings.detail: Could not connect to http://testphp.vulnweb.com on HTTP or HTTPS

ai_triage.title: Connection Failed
ai_triage.explanation: This is an informational finding with no direct security impact. It provides useful context about the target system.
ai_triage.impact: This vulnerability could impact the security posture of the application and its users.
ai_triage.fix: 1. Review and fix the identified vulnerability following OWASP guidelines. 2. Test the fix in staging before deploying. 3. Rescan after patching.

findings.detail: Could not connect to testphp.vulnweb.com:443 — HTTPS may not be configured

ai_triage.title: SSL: Port 443 Unreachable
ai_triage.explanation: This is a medium severity issue that should be addressed soon. It may allow attackers to gather information or perform limited attacks.
ai_triage.impact: This vulnerability could impact the security posture of the application and its users.
ai_triage.fix: 1. Install a valid SSL certificate (Let's Encrypt is free). 2. Enable HTTPS redirect from HTTP. 3. Configure HSTS header.
